arabic text: Jawani gham manati hai, Ajal aansu bahati hai\nKafan shadi ka jora hai, Dulhan sadme uthati hai\nAjal aansu bahati hai
english translation text: Youth itself mourns, and death sheds tears;\nthe wedding clothes became a shroud, while the bride endured grief.\nDeath itself sheds tears.

arabic text: Huwa dulha lahoo paikar, Hai barati bhi khoon me tar\nKahaan sehra kahaan menhdi, Chupe sab khaak ke andar\nHuwi yeh kaisi shadi hai, Jo ab tak khoon rulati hai
english translation text: The groom was covered in blood, and the wedding party too was drenched in blood.\nWhere was the wedding crown, and where was the henna? All lay hidden beneath the dust.\nWhat kind of wedding was this, which still makes people weep blood?

arabic text: Hasan ki yaad me paiham, Hai aankhen shahe deen ki nam\nNishani bhai ki haye, Zameen pe torti hai dam\nNazar maqtal me bhai ki, Unhe tasweer aati hai
english translation text: The King's eyes remain wet in remembrance of Hasan;\nalas, his brother's keepsake breathes his last upon the ground.\nWithin the battlefield, the image of his brother appears before him.

arabic text: Abhi to phool sehre ke, Nahi dulha ke murjaye\nKe dunya se chala dulha, Qayamat hogayi haye\nSada matam ki jo uthe, Falak ko woh hilati hai
english translation text: The flowers of the wedding crown had not yet withered\nwhen the groom departed this world—alas, Judgement Day arose.\nThe cry of matam that rises shakes the heavens.

arabic text: Har ek tukre ko chun chun kar, Fughan karte hai yoon sarwar\nYeh ghatri me tera lasha, Sahegi kus tarhan madar\nKe farwa ke tasawur se, Humari jaan jaati haiu
english translation text: Gathering every piece one by one, Sarwar lamented:\nhow will your mother bear seeing your body wrapped in this bundle?\nThe thought of Farwa takes away our very lives.

arabic text: Parhi tehreer bhai ki, Ijazat ran ki dedi thi\nJo ek taweez ki soorat, Tere bazoo pe lipti thi\nWohi tehreer ab dilpar, Mere khanjar chalati hai
english translation text: He read his brother's writing and granted permission for battle;\nit was wrapped around your arm in the form of an amulet.\nThat same writing now cuts like a dagger into my heart.

arabic text: Jigar tukre hasan ka tha, Jo zainab ne bhi tha dekha\nWohi manzar hai maqtal me, Badan tukre bhatije ka\nMusalsal yaad mazi ki, Bohot dil ko dukhati hai
english translation text: Hasan's liver was torn to pieces, a sight Zainab had witnessed;\nnow in the battlefield lies the body of her nephew in pieces.\nThe unending memory of the past deeply wounds the heart.

arabic text: Thi ek shab ki dulhan bewa, Huwa pamal tha dulha\nBhala salman lafzon me, Ada ho kis tarha pursa\nKe jab tehreer khud meri, Mujhe noha sunati hai
english translation text: The bride of one night became a widow, while the groom was trampled.\nO "Salman", how can condolences be fully expressed in words,\nwhen my own writing begins reciting the lament back to me?
